methodologyNotes: Roster covers nine H-frame hydraulic shop presses from 5 to 30 tons capacity, spanning basic hand-pump consumer units (Central Machinery) through air/hydraulic hybrid presses (Black Widow) to industrial hand-operated machines (Dake, Baileigh, JET). Five entries (Baileigh HSP-20A, Dake 25H, Central Machinery 70603, Black Widow BD-PRESS-20A, JET HP-5A) were directly verified against live retailer/manufacturer pages (Penn Tool Co., Elite Metal Tools, Harbor Freight, Discount Ramps, Bright Steel Solutions) with fetched source + corroboration URLs and full specs. Four entries (Grizzly G7150, Eastwood 20-Ton, Palmgren 25-Ton, Klutch 30-Ton) are real, long-running catalog SKUs whose granular dimensional specs could not be freshly re-fetched: their manufacturer/retailer pages returned bot-detection blocks (403/405) or exceeded the fetch tool's parseable size, so those pages exist but could not be parsed to positively confirm the product or extract specs; capacity/frame/pump type are populated from well-established manufacturer literature and dimensional fields are left null rather than guessed. ADVERSARIAL CORRECTION (this verification pass): three prior entries were REMOVED because their constructed source URLs were proven dead/fabricated and their products could not be independently confirmed — (1) 'Torin Big Red T51201' at torinbigred.com, a domain that does not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND); (2) 'Sunex 5720AH' at sunextools.com/product/5720ah/, which returns HTTP 404; (3) 'OTC 1835 25 Ton Shop Press' at otctools.com/products/1835-shop-press, which resolves to a generic OTC jack listing (bottle/service jacks only) rather than any shop-press product page. A prior seed correction also stands: seed model 'JET J-9020' does not exist in JET's catalog; JET's actual hydraulic shop press line is the HP-5A/HP-15A/HP-35A family (per JET/JPW operating manual part #331406), and the seed was replaced with the real, fully-documented JET HP-5A 5-ton press. accessedAt 2026-08-12 throughout; priceUsd is populated only where a specific figure was independently confirmed on a fetched page and left null everywhere else per no-guessing policy.

products.name: JET HP-5A 5 Ton Hand-Operated Hydraulic Shop Press
products.priceNote: Authorized-dealer list price (Bright Steel Solutions); JET does not sell direct-to-consumer.
products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model "JET J-9020" does not exist in JET's catalog — no J-9020 product page, manual, or retailer listing was found anywhere, and JET's forming/press category (jettools.com) shows no J-9xxx hydraulic shop press series at all. JET's actual hydraulic shop press line, per JET/JPW Industries' own operating manual (part #331406, hosted on JET's S3 asset bucket), is the HP-5A/HP-15A/HP-35A family (5-ton, 15-ton, and 35-ton respectively) — there is no 20-ton model in the line. The seed was replaced with the smallest, most fully documented model, HP-5A, confirmed via Bright Steel Solutions (authorized JET dealer): 5-ton capacity, 4 in. piston stroke, 1-3/4 in. ram diameter, 3 in. screw stroke, 19 in. vertical table travel, 159 lb weight, hand-operated hydraulic pump with pressure gauge, $1,860 price. Working width was not published on the fetched page and is left null rather than assumed.
